titleEn: Maximum Number of Balls in a Box
title: 盒子中小球的最大数量
summary: 编号 lowLimit 到 highLimit 的球按编号各位数字和放入对应盒子，求任一盒子中的最多球数。
insight: 逐编号计算十进制数位和并累计盒子频次，同时维护最大频次。范围不大，直接模拟足够。
pitfalls: 盒子编号是数位和而非球编号
相同数位和累积到同一盒

solutions.title: 数位和频次模拟
solutions.idea: 对每个球计算唯一目标盒并计数。
steps: number 从 lowLimit 到 highLimit 计算 digitSum

code.java: class Solution { private int digitSum(int value){int sum=0;while(value>0){sum+=value%10;value/=10;}return sum;}public int countBalls(int lowLimit,int highLimit){int[] counts=new int[50];int answer=0;for(int value=lowLimit;value<=highLimit;value++)answer=Math.max(answer,++counts[digitSum(value)]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countBalls(lowLimit:Int,highLimit:Int):Int{val counts=IntArray(50);var answer=0;for(original in lowLimit..highLimit){var value=original;var sum=0;while(value>0){sum+=value%10;value/=10};counts[sum]++;answer=maxOf(answer,counts[sum])};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int digitSum(int value){int sum=0;while(value){sum+=value%10;value/=10;}return sum;}public:int countBalls(int lowLimit,int highLimit){int counts[50]={},answer=0;for(int value=lowLimit;value<=highLimit;++value)answer=max(answer,++counts[digitSum(value)]);return answer;} };
